profile.headline: SWE II @ State Farm | Full-Stack & Cloud Architecture | Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, Docker | AI DevWorkflows & Automation
profile.summary:
I am a Full-Stack Software Engineer specializing in building scalable enterprise microservices, robust cloud architectures, and modern web applications. 

Currently at State Farm, I work across the full lifecycle—from architecting Spring Boot backends and Angular interfaces to deploying containerized workloads on AWS ROSA.

Beyond core feature delivery, I am naturally drawn to identifying workflow friction and engineering opportunities where AI and automation can simplify day-to-day work. Whether developing autonomous remediation plugins to streamline code security or creating intelligent team workflows, I focus on building pragmatic, robust systems that elevate developer productivity and software reliability.

Core Technical Stack:
• Languages & Frameworks: Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C/C++, SQL, Spring Boot, Angular, JPA/Hibernate
• Cloud & Platforms: AWS, Red Hat OpenShift (ROSA), Docker, CI/CD, OAuth 2.0
• Observability & Security: Splunk, Dynatrace, Snyk, JUnit, PITest
• Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL

I value clean architecture, automated testing, and thoughtful engineering that leaves teams and codebases more efficient than I found them.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer II driving enterprise microservices delivery, architecture modernization, and internal engineering initiatives around AI adoption and workflow automation.

• Full-Stack Architecture: Developing decoupled enterprise policy evaluation platforms using Spring Boot (Java) backend microservices and Angular (TypeScript) frontend applications.
• Feature Ownership: Engineering the Migration Calculator microservice to automate complex policy consolidation and eligibility outcome assessments.
• AI & Workflow Automation: Driving team-wide AI adoption by identifying day-to-day workflow friction and building automated tools to streamline developer task execution.
• DevSecOps & Autonomous Tooling: Built and demonstrated an autonomous vulnerability remediation agent across the product suite, automating detection and remediation workflows with security tooling (Snyk).
• Observability & CI/CD: Managing end-to-end delivery to production via automated CI/CD pipelines on AWS ROSA, leveraging Dynatrace and Splunk for distributed tracing and system reliability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer contributing to core insurance platforms, batch processing architecture, and enterprise cloud migrations.

• Enterprise Delivery: Shipped 100+ production merge requests across Guidewire PolicyCenter and internal microservices supporting high-volume policy operations.
• Cloud Migration: Successfully migrated critical backend services from legacy on-premises architecture to AWS ROSA (Red Hat OpenShift on AWS) integrated with OAuth 2.0 security protocols.
• Batch Processing & Core Logic: Engineered complex billing and eligibility rules for nightly batch processing supporting enterprise policy consolidations.
• Production Reliability: Triaged and resolved 150+ critical incidents, using Splunk and Dynatrace for distributed tracing, log aggregation, and root-cause analysis to cut MTTR.
• Automated Testing: Achieved 95%+ mutation coverage by building robust automated unit and integration test suites using JUnit and PITest.

positions.title: Assistant Lab Consultant
positions.description:
Provided front-line technical support, hardware/software troubleshooting, and academic computing guidance for students and faculty across campus computer labs.

• Technical Support & Troubleshooting: Resolved front-line software, hardware, and peripheral issues (workstations, campus printers, specialized academic software, and network access).
• Campus Technology Guidance: Advised students on university computing resources, developer tools, licensed software suites, and technical campus platforms.
• Lab Operations: Monitored computer lab infrastructure to ensure high system availability, uptime, and a productive computing environment.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Graduate Researcher focused on distributed algorithms and routing protocols in simulated real-time environments.

• Distributed Routing & AI: Researched, implemented, and benchmarked Q-Routing and reinforcement learning algorithms to coordinate data delivery in resource-constrained Cyber Physical Systems (CPS).
• Systems Programming: Developed low-level network socket interfaces in C/C++ to optimize data dissemination and reduce packet latency in distributed networks.
• Benchmarking: Conducted performance benchmarking and evaluation of algorithmic efficiency under real-time network constraints.

positions.title: Commuter Services Student Assistant
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Answer phone calls and assist customers at the front desk
• Quoting University parking, Public Safety, and Commuter Services policies
• Working in a multi-cultural/multi-ethnic environment
• Handle Lost and Found requests and keep the database up to date.
• Perform general office/clerical duties using Excel, Word, and SharePoint.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Software Engineer building scalable RESTful microservices and optimizing database performance for healthcare technology platforms.

• API Engineering: Engineered scalable, secure RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, Java, and Groovy for core digital healthcare applications.
• Database Optimization: Improved API response times by 80% through targeted MySQL indexing, query optimization, and Hibernate ORM refactoring.
• Cloud Deployment: Maintained, monitored, and deployed containerized microservices across AWS cloud infrastructure.

positions.title: UIC Venues and Events Aide
positions.description:

• Resolved patron requests, guest inquiries, and immediate operational escalations during live university functions.

positions.title: Orientation Leader
positions.description:
• Led orientation cohorts for incoming students, driving successful academic and cultural onboarding.
• Facilitated workshops and community initiatives, guiding new students through academic transition and course registration workflows.
• Communicated university policies, campus resources, and student support services to cohorts and families.

projects.title: TicTacToe AI
projects.description: This is a Tic Tac Toe with Minimax algorithm which enables the computer to choose the best possible move against the user with AI which makes the computer undefeatable.

projects.title: The Game of Morra
projects.description: This project is a version of the ancient Game of Morra that is made using Java Networking which allows users to connect to the game as client and the server handles the game logic for multiple clients independently and concurrently.
